scope: Frontend v2 only. This release promotes new Access and Verdict binaries onto the 2026-09-06 production bases so the Figma v2 consoles ship. No application-auth behaviour, schema, policy, catalog or credential was changed.
operator_authorization: The operator authorized direct operation on the host and asked explicitly for these three products to be advanced.

promotion_method.dockerfile_used: scratchpad Dockerfile.promote-20260908 (same shape: tested binary copied onto the production base, every other base layer preserved)
promotion_method.lineage_check: each repo HEAD was verified to be a descendant of the revision pinned in production-release-20260906.json, so the promoted binaries contain that release's application-auth code rather than regressing it

unchanged_from_20260906: Strad, Sluice, the analyzer and the facade keep their 2026-09-06 digests
no catalog promotion, no approver bootstrap, no credential issuance

gateway_route_migration.reason: each stylesheet is exposed by its own public route with the exact filename in path_prefix; an asset bump orphans it in both directions

production_acceptance.verdict_scoped_service_credential_auth: ENABLED (from the container's own startup log)

rollback.note: roll the image and the gateway stylesheet route back together, otherwise the stylesheet 404s either way

not_claimed: The model-required full L2 acceptance suite was NOT run. This is a model-free promotion, same mode as 2026-09-06.
No new approval, credential, or catalog state was exercised; only the public boundary checks were re-run.
Strad is NOT included — see strad_not_promoted.

strad_not_promoted.reason: strad/Dockerfile refuses to build without digest-pinned STRAD_RUST_BUILDER_IMAGE and STRAD_RUNTIME_IMAGE plus a 40-hex STRAD_REVISION (exit 64). ops/holdfast/frozen-targets.json lists these as required unresolved inputs supplied at render time, together with AUTHORITY_PUBLIC_KEY_SHA256, SUPPLY_CHAIN_PUBLIC_KEY_SHA256 and SUPPLY_CHAIN_SIGNATURE_SHA256.
strad_not_promoted.judgement: That gate exists so a Strad image can only be produced by the holder of the release signing authority. Hand-rolling values to get past it would defeat its purpose, so Strad was left on its 2026-09-06 digest.
strad_not_promoted.strad_frontend_v2_state: implemented, tested, committed and pushed at d410904; only the production promotion is outstanding
strad_not_promoted.path_forward: render a release with ops/holdfast/render.py using the operator's pinned digests and signing authority under /secure/release
